title: The builder-brief check accepts a done-check label followed by a blank line and bullets, or a fence with a blank or # line
why: Lane builder-brief-code-check (session_013NEJL2nvHYs3wA2QnMZfJG), 12:22 CST Nov 8: PR #2204 files debt builder-done-label-blank-line. Rule builder-brief-code-check refuses a valid brief whose done-check label is followed by a blank line then bullets naming the lint, and one whose done check is a fence holding a blank or `#` line. A fix was tried and reverted: an unclosed fence, or a fence opened on the label line, let a later paragraph pass as the done check. Run as its own lane after #2204.
